overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair could not reasonably have anticipated the weekend-arranged topic 48 hours before the June 25, 2012 meeting. The AG declined the added complaint-response allegation as outside the original complaint, reminding the Board that it must first review OML complaints.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed a topic at its June 25, 2012 meeting that was not listed in the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Since the discussion between Mr. Maio and Ms. Hull occurred over the weekend before the Monday meeting, Chair Sheeran could not have reasonably anticipated, at least 48 hours before the meeting, excluding Saturdays and Sundays, that this would be a topic of discussion.

allegations.summary: Complaint additionally alleged the Board did not review, discuss or respond to the complaint filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: While we decline to review the additional allegation because it is beyond the scope of the original complaint filed with the public body
